key_highlights: RBA signals continued rate hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' decline, pressuring ASX foreign-earning sectors
Banks and miners drag ASX lower following a shaky Wall Street session; however, equities remain resilient amid broader asset devaluation
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline, with Victoria hit hardest on unemployment
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need, raising long-term fiscal risk
Gold and copper exploration results (Aurum, Zenith, Rio2, Sarytogan, Aureka) signal sustained junior-miner activity
Jetstar staff escalate industrial action, waiving fees; consumer travel sector under pressure
Data centre energy demand threatens grid capacity, creating a structural energy tension

sectors.trend: Banks weigh on ASX as RBA hikes into rising unemployment; NIMs under pressure from rate pincer; credit risk rising with 50%+ of renters financially stressed
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression and elevated NPL risk; defensive dividend appeal intact but growth outlook muted

sectors.trend: Large-caps (BHP, RIO, FMG) pressured by Wall Street spillover and AUD weakness; juniors active with strong gold/copper drill results (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits, Rio2 Peru copper, Sarytogan 452m copper)
sectors.implications: AUD weakness supports commodity exporters' AUD earnings; junior gold/copper names offer speculative upside but remain capital-constrained

sectors.trend: Data centre boom strains grid capacity ('energy bust'); structural demand for power generation and transmission infrastructure
sectors.implications: Energy producers and grid operators (e.g., AGL.AX, CGP.AX, SPG.AX) benefit from sustained capex cycle; renewable developers face permitting delays

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; Ozempic boom disrupts fast-food demand; consumer spending squeezed by rate pincer and housing stress
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption; WES.AX, WOW.AX, AWD.AX under margin pressure from weak discretionary spend

sectors.trend: Measles outbreak and flu season peak drive public health spending; OpenAI Medicare data breach raises cybersecurity concerns in health sector
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, HIC.AX benefit from public health demand; cybersecurity spend in health IT rises

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to 40-year decline; CBD tower listed at $40m; Dusty Martin sells $20m portfolio; renter stress at 50%+
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face falling valuations; commercial property under pressure; residential REITs see reduced tenant demand

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot into recessionary unemployment data creates policy dilemma
AUD 'trapdoor' weakens importers but supports commodity exporters
Housing market correction accelerates, testing financial system stability
Intergenerational Report signals long-term fiscal deterioration
Gold/copper exploration pipeline remains robust across WA and international
AI/tech momentum in US (Nvidia, AMD, Salesforce) provides global risk-on counterweight
Energy infrastructure demand from data centres creates structural tailwind

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes into rising unemployment (stagflation risk)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (healthcare, staples); reduce leverage; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge FX exposure; favour AUD-earning commodity exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX); avoid import-heavy consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market 40-year decline and renter stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property REITs and construction; monitor NAB/CBA credit loss provisions; favour cash-flowing dividend payers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Intergenerational fiscal deterioration / tax reform uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor Treasury policy signals; favour companies with low tax sensitivity; avoid over-exposure to government-dependent sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action / consumer travel disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce QAN.AX exposure short-term; monitor Qantas group earnings guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global tech/AI volatility spillover to ASX
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from single-sector concentration; use ASX 200 ETFs for broad exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper juniors on strong drill results and AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits, Rio2 Peru copper, Sarytogan 452m copper signal resource upside; AUD depreciation boosts AUD-denominated commodity earnings

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy/grid infrastructure exposure on data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural power demand from data centres creates multi-year capex cycle for generators and transmission operators

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain defensive dividend positions in healthcare and staples
opportunities.rationale: Measles/flu outbreaks support CSL demand; rate pincer makes high-yield defensives attractive

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline, CBD tower distress sales, and 50%+ renter stress signal prolonged property downturn

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure and reduce import-heavy consumer names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' raises input costs for importers; consumer spending already squeezed by rate pincer

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim QAN.AX ahead of industrial action escalation
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar staff waiving fees signals revenue loss; broader Qantas group earnings at risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure as RBA hawkishness, AUD weakness, and housing stress dominate. Banks and miners drag index lower. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US spillover. Gold/copper juniors provide relative outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: Intergenerational Report signals structural fiscal risk requiring tax reform. Housing correction may stabilise within 12 months. Commodity cycle supportive for miners. Energy transition and data centre demand create multi-year infrastructure tailwinds. RBA pivot likely once unemployment peaks.
